security_rights_budget_impact: Adds credential redaction in logging (Bearer/sk-/AKIA/URL creds/password-token values) and redacted pg_dump error paths; no network calls at init in default none mode; no secrets introduced.
known_limitations: Real Postgres pg_dump integration test and CI execution happen outside this network-restricted sandbox.
No OTLP/Prometheus exporter, scheduler, or backup encryption: explicitly future scope per packet and 12 runbook.
Manifest id/created_at differ across runs; item hashes are deterministic (documented in backup.py).
